units.source_text: 庭院中的松树，虽非源氏公子手植，

en.t: Although the pine tree in the garden had not been planted by Prince Genji himself,

units.source_text: 但见其已比昔年高大得多，

en.t: he saw that it had already grown much taller than in former years,

units.source_text: 不免痛感年月之流逝，慨叹此身沉浮若梦。

en.t: and he could not help feeling keenly the passage of time, lamenting that the rises and falls of his own life were like a dream.

units.source_text: 便口占诗句，对末摘花吟道：

en.t: Then he composed a poem on the spot and recited it to Suetsumuhana:
